an9.45:1.2: kittāvatā nu kho āvuso ubhatobhāgavimutto vutto bhagavatāti:
an9.45:2.1: idhāvuso bhikkhu vivicceva kāmehi …pe… paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati,
an9.45:2.2: yathā yathā ca tadāyatanaṃ tathā tathā naṃ kāyena phassitvā viharati, paññāya ca naṃ pajānāti. ettāvatā pi kho āvuso ubhatobhāgavimutto vutto bhagavatā pariyāyena …pe… puna caparaṃ āvuso bhikkhu sabbaso ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati yathā yathā ca tadāyatanaṃ tathā tathā naṃ kāyena phassitvā viharati, paññāya ca naṃ pajānāti.
an9.45:2.3: ettāvatāpi kho āvuso ubhatobhāgavimutto vutto bhagavatā pariyāyena.
an9.45:3.1: puna caparaṃ āvuso bhikkhu sabbaso nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ upasampajja viharati paññāya cassa disvā āsavā parikkhīṇā honti.
an9.45:3.2: yathā yathā ca tadāyatanaṃ tathā tathā naṃ kāyena phassitvā viharati. paññāya ca naṃ pajānāti.
an9.45:3.3: ettāvatāpi kho āvuso ubhatobhāgavimutto vutto bhagavatā nippariyāyenāti.
